episodes.name: Wayward Son
episodes.overview: While dealing with the fallout from the shooting involving McGee’s son, the team investigates a mysterious new threat to the Secretary of the Navy and receives help from an unexpected source: Tony DiNozzo, newly arrived in D.C. to open a satellite office of his private security firm.

episodes.name: Clean Slate
episodes.overview: When a man is murdered after a neighborhood dinner party, the team discovers every guest is lying – about the strange break-in at the victim’s house, what they were burning in their backyards and who they really are. And the deeper the team digs, the less they can agree on what kind of case they’re even working.

episodes.name: Sleeping Dogs
episodes.overview: When Torres’ retired undercover identity is used to commit a string of murders, he’s forced to team up with his grizzled old-school former handler, Walt Keller, and confront a darker version of himself that he thought he’d left behind.

episodes.name: Like and Subscribe
episodes.overview: When a sailor moonlighting as a contestant on an online game show turns up murdered, the team discovers his death has nothing to do with the show’s prize money. Also, Tony faces a threat far more intimidating than any killer.
